authority.scope: ODA v5.4.1 section 9 pages 74-75 lists PELLIPSE, ISOLINES, TEXTQLTY, and FACETRES in the common DWG header; PELLIPSE is explicitly annotated as not present in DXF.
Original R14 DXF HEADER reference does not list any of the four names.

observation: The current DXF writer generates these four names in selected AC1014 output; LibreDWG 0.14 conversions of two separately sourced AC1014 drawings omit them. This is a bounded comparison, not evidence of native acceptance, permitted extensions, or a safe blanket loss policy.
next: Distinguish imported DWG common-header values from explicit DXF and application-supplied values; evaluate defaults and nondefaults, source loss reporting, existing DXF extensions, and native producer/consumer behavior. Avoid blanket failure of ordinary DWG conversion; require atomic refusal or explicit supported loss handling where information cannot be preserved.
limits: No production behavior changed and no support claim promoted.
The converted source drawings and outputs remain scratch-only.
